description: This file provides template specializations and functions for converting C++ STL data types (like vector, list, set, map, optional, variant) to and from Python objects using pybind11. It includes type casters for various STL containers and utilities for handling Python iterable and mapping types.

classes.name: set_caster
classes.description: Type caster for converting Python set-like objects to C++ std::set or std::unordered_set.

classes.name: map_caster
classes.description: Type caster for converting Python dict-like objects to C++ std::map or std::unordered_map.

classes.name: list_caster
classes.description: Type caster for converting Python sequence-like objects to C++ std::vector, std::deque, or std::list.

classes.name: array_caster
classes.description: Type caster for converting Python iterable to fixed-size C++ array or std::valarray.

classes.name: optional_caster
classes.description: Type caster for std::optional and std::experimental::optional types.

classes.name: variant_caster
classes.description: Type caster for std::variant and boost::variant types.

methods.name: object_is_instance_with_one_of_tp_names
methods.description: Checks if a Python object is an instance of one of the given type names.

methods.name: object_is_convertible_to_std_vector
methods.description: Determines if a Python object can be converted to a C++ std::vector.

methods.name: object_is_convertible_to_std_set
methods.description: Determines if a Python object can be converted to a C++ std::set.

methods.name: object_is_convertible_to_std_map
methods.description: Determines if a Python object can be converted to a C++ std::map.

methods.name: forward_like
methods.description: Forwards a value as lvalue or rvalue depending on the container's reference type.
